### Co-ocurrence

I have made a table that has the number of nodules that I harvested per pair, and it also has the % of mucoid, dry and mixture. I also have the barplots in this code. The Data_input is added as well. 

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
## Document that has the single nodule data open 
getwd()

Individual_nodule_data <- read_excel(here("Data_input/Single_nodule_data.xlsx"))
unique(Individual_nodule_data$Morphology)
Individual_nodule_data <- Individual_nodule_data %>% filter(Morphology %in% c("Dry", "Mucoid", "Mixture")) #Remove contaminants and morphologies that did not have a clear morphology
View(Individual_nodule_data)
### Create a table that shows the proportions of each morphology in the nodules 

function_pair <- function(Partner) {c(
  Name = Partner, 
  nrow(Individual_nodule_data %>% filter(Name == Partner)),
  sprintf("%.3f", 100*nrow(Individual_nodule_data %>% filter(Name == Partner & Morphology == "Mucoid"))/nrow(Individual_nodule_data %>% filter(Name == Partner))),
  sprintf("%.3f", 100*nrow(Individual_nodule_data %>% filter(Name == Partner & Morphology == "Dry"))/nrow(Individual_nodule_data %>% filter(Name == Partner))),
  sprintf("%.3f", 100*nrow(Individual_nodule_data %>% filter(Name == Partner & Morphology == "Mixture"))/nrow(Individual_nodule_data %>% filter(Name == Partner))))
}

#unique(Individual_nodule_data$Name)
Table_mix_percentage <- rbind(function_pair("091_101"), function_pair("015_099"), function_pair("016_100"), function_pair("029_098"))
Table_mix_percentage <- as.data.frame(Table_mix_percentage)
Table_mix_percentage

colnames(Table_mix_percentage) <- c("Pair", "Number of nodules", "% Mucoid", "% Dry", "% Mixture")

Table_mix_percentage

write_xlsx(Table_mix_percentage, here("Tables/TableA_FromR.xlsx"))

## Total number of nodules with mixture and with single 

## Total of nodules with valid assessment (taking out the contaminations). The results suggest that from 225 nodules, 83% have a single morphology, either mucoid or dry, wherease mixtures occupy around 17% of the nodules. The data broken down is in the upper part. 

Total_nod_number <- nrow(Individual_nodule_data)
Total_nod_number #225 from an initial of 70*4 = 280


percentage_mixture <- nrow(Individual_nodule_data %>% filter(Morphology == "Mixture"))/nrow(Individual_nodule_data)*100
percentage_mixture #16.889
percentage_single <- nrow(Individual_nodule_data %>% filter(Morphology %in% c("Mucoid", "Dry")))/nrow(Individual_nodule_data)*100
percentage_single #83.111



## Plot

color_values <- c("Mucoid" = "#4eadb9",
                  "Dry" = "#e0ba3e",
                  "Mixture" = "#97b47c")

coocurrence <- ggplot(Individual_nodule_data, 
       aes(x = Name, 
           fill = Morphology)) + 
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_values)+
  labs(x = "Pair", y = "Proportion")+
  theme(axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 14)) +
  theme_bw()

ggsave(coocurrence, 
       filename = here("Figures" ,"coocurrence.pdf"),
       device = "pdf",
       height = 4, width = 6, units = "in")

```

### How many plants have a shift from dry to mucoid bacteria in the dual inoculation experiments.  

```{r}


### Limitations with these experiments is that I never really got to re-streak the colonies to confirm the phenotype for both examples.

HarvestingDualSingle <- read_excel("~/OneDrive - The Pennsylvania State University/Burghardt Lab Shared Folder/Projects/NIFA-AVT-AlfalfaProjects/Aim1bAVT_StrainCollection/Chapter1_Partners_Mariale/Experiments/Dual_inoculation_experiment/Harvesting experiments/Harvesting_results_MASTER.xlsx", sheet = 1)

View(HarvestingDualSingle)


Harvesting_Single_Mucoid <- HarvestingDualSingle %>% filter(Morphology == "Mucoid")
Harvesting_Single_Mucoid <-   Harvesting_Single_Mucoid %>% filter(Number_unilobed != "NA") %>% filter(Dilution != "NA") ## Eliminate the ones that do not have nodules
View(Harvesting_Single_Mucoid) # 4 out of 22 plants had at least 1 dry colony recovered from the nodules


Harvest_Single_Dry <- HarvestingDualSingle %>% filter(Morphology == "Dry")
Harvest_Single_Dry <-   Harvest_Single_Dry  %>% filter(Number_unilobed != "NA") %>% filter(Dilution != "NA") ## Eliminate the ones that do not have nodules
View(Harvest_Single_Dry) ## According to my notes 1 out of 19 plants had at least 1 colony that looked mucoid. 

### Create a new column with the total number of cells. Nodule pooles were put in 3ml of saline solution and then they were homogenized. Then I took 100ul for teh dilution plating and then I plated 100ul. The calculated CFU per plant is 3*CFU*10^(Dil+1)

CFU_Single_Mucoid <- HarvestingDualSingle %>%
  mutate(
    Colonies_Par   = as.numeric(as.character(Colonies_Par)),
    Colonies_rhizo = as.numeric(as.character(Colonies_rhizo)),
    Dilution       = as.numeric(as.character(Dilution))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Dry_CFU_Total    = Colonies_Par * 3 * 10^(Dilution + 1),
    Mucoid_CFU_Total = Colonies_rhizo * 3 * 10^(Dilution + 1),
    Total_CFU        = Dry_CFU_Total + Mucoid_CFU_Total
  )

View(CFU_Single_Mucoid)

ggplot(CFU_Single_Mucoid %>% filter(Morphology == "Mucoid"), aes(x= Code, y = Total_CFU)) +
  geom_jitter()

ggplot(CFU_Single_Mucoid %>% filter(Morphology == "Dry"), aes(x= Code, y = Total_CFU)) +
  geom_jitter()

ggplot(CFU_Single_Mucoid %>% filter(!Morphology %in% c("Control", "Dual")), aes(x= Code, y = log10(Total_CFU), col= Morphology)) +
  geom_jitter() +
  facet_wrap(~Morphology)

ggplot(CFU_Single_Mucoid %>% filter(!Morphology %in% c("Control", "Dual")), aes(x= Morphology, y = log10(Total_CFU), fill= Morphology)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_jitter() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_values) +
  theme_minimal() ## I do not know how trustworthy this is given that all of these are plants but there are at least 4 strains involved. Should I care about that, how do I account for that? 



```
